name: sdrift-toolz-toolz-001-shared
instr:
# Restore toolz's documented behaviour

Somewhere in `/app` (toolz, a functional utility library for iterators, dictionaries, and callable composition) the implementation has diverged from the behaviour its
documentation promises (the prose documentation under `/app/doc/source/` and the implementation docstrings under `/app/toolz/`). Everything still runs, which is why it slipped through. Find the
disagreement(s) between code and docs and bring the code back in line.

Only touch `/app/toolz/`; keep the API, signatures and files as they are. Offline only. Grading replays
hidden inputs against the documented behaviour (deterministic iterator, nested-dictionary, and callable-introspection operations).

Before editing, write a short plan to /app/APPROACH.md — what the docs specify, where the code diverges, and how you'll verify your fix — then implement it.
